note: Rejudged after commit f88f5b6a3d replaced logger.Warn with reportLCPWriteFailure on the unsupported-protocol LCP Protocol-Reject write failure path in keepaliveLoop (network_phase.go:214). Re-read RFC 1661 Section 4.3's Implementation Note under RCR+/RCR- ('These events may occur on a connection which is already in the Opened state. The implementation MUST be prepared to immediately renegotiate the Configuration Options.') and verified all five producers and six tagged tests. In keepaliveLoop, clientSupportsProtocol unconditionally admits ProtoLCP (0xC021), so an LCP Configure-Request bypasses the Protocol-Reject branch and reaches requestLCPReentry and reenter(reentry), which stops echo timing, lowers IPv6CP if configured, cancels any armed no-NCP idle timer, and calls connectedSession.restart -> negotiatePhases; a *lcpReentry returned from handleIPCP also routes into reenter. All six tagged test units remain byte-identical and continue to enforce the requirement: TestRFC1661RenegotiateOnConfigureRequestInOpened asserts exact [tld, scr, sca] -> Ack-Sent (RCR+) and [tld, scr, scn] -> Req-Sent (RCR-); TestRFC1661ConfigureRequestInOpenedRenegotiates asserts handleLCPPacket writes Configure-Request and Configure-Ack, moves to Ack-Sent, keeps the session running, and emits no EventSessionDown; TestRFC1661EchoDoesNotRenegotiate confirms RXR in Opened stays Opened with no scr/tld; TestRFC1661ClientRenegotiatesLCPDuringAuth, TestRFC1661ClientRenegotiatesLCPDuringIPCP, and TestRFC1661ClientRenegotiatesLCPInNetworkPhase assert own Configure-Request immediately preceding exact Configure-Ack for Identifier 0x73 and Magic-Number 0x55667788.
